task: Extend the existing Control Plane release verification with safe resumable evidence reuse and minimal replay without creating a parallel authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This changes the Control Plane evidence-reuse decision path. False reuse can create a false PASS, so semantic fingerprints, transitive invalidation, branch-scoped checkpoint reconciliation, corruption detection, fail-closed unknown handling and shadow comparison are mandatory. Full formal verification and perfect repository-wide static dependency analysis are disproportionate for this bounded deterministic CI orchestration model.

deferredTechniques.reason: Exhaustive state scenarios plus shadow/full equivalence provide stronger practical assurance per engineering cost for this bounded evaluator.
Explicit semantic inputs and fail-closed unknowns avoid brittle over-analysis while preserving correctness.
v1 remains branch-scoped to avoid identity and cache-poisoning risk.

acceptanceCriteria: Reusable PASS evidence is justified by deterministic semantic-input, gate-version, authority, configuration, toolchain and dependency fingerprints.
Changed, uncertain or unsupported input invalidates the affected gate and downstream verification dependencies.
Known Failure regression scope can widen the minimal replay scope.
Every checkpoint is reconciled against the new exact HEAD before any resume decision.
The exact-head evidence manifest records rerun/reused proofs, original revision and equivalence proof.
Dirty workspace, branch mismatch, corrupted/incomplete checkpoint, unsupported change and unknown dependency fail closed.
Shadow mode compares predicted reuse with full verification and blocks on any false-reuse discrepancy.
The existing Control Plane and subordinate authorities remain the only final authorities.
Template Factory may reuse unchanged page/viewport browser evidence only after branch-scoped checkpoint reconciliation; ambiguous/shared/authority changes force the full 14x3 matrix.
invariants: A previous PASS alone is never sufficient for reuse.
Gate implementation changes invalidate that gate and downstream dependents.
Authority or policy changes invalidate every dependent proof.
Cross-branch reuse is disabled in v1.
The checkpoint is data only and never becomes a parallel authority.
Full verification remains authoritative during shadow mode.

alternatives.summary: Keep exact-HEAD evidence only and rerun every gate.
alternatives.reason: Safe but preserves unnecessary repeated verification and does not satisfy resumable verification.

alternatives.summary: Extend the existing Incremental Replay and Truth evidence path with semantic fingerprints, checkpoint reconciliation and a verification dependency graph.
alternatives.reason: Reuses current Control Plane authority and enables minimal safe replay without a parallel CI system.

alternatives.summary: Introduce a standalone cache service or independent replay orchestrator.
alternatives.reason: Creates a second authority surface and unnecessary cache/operations risk.

specialistReviews.finding: Verification dependencies must remain inside the existing Control Plane model.
specialistReviews.resolution: Gate verification metadata and Incremental Replay own planning; no new blocking authority.

specialistReviews.finding: Skipping a previously green gate can create a false exact-head PASS.
specialistReviews.resolution: v1 is branch-scoped shadow mode; only fingerprint-equivalent evidence is reusable and any full-run disagreement blocks the engine.

specialistReviews.finding: Checkpoint corruption or partial writes could poison evidence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Checksummed complete checkpoints and atomic writes fail closed on corruption.

specialistReviews.finding: Diff-only replay can miss recurring regression scope.
specialistReviews.resolution: Known Failure regression scopes can only widen replay.

specialistReviews.finding: Cancelled or concurrent runs must not leave ambiguous resume points.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only finalized complete checkpoints are reusable; branch concurrency remains canonical.

challenge.scenario: Local fix changes one semantic input.
challenge.resolution: Reuse unchanged fingerprints; rerun changed gate and downstream dependents.
Explicit input patterns and dependency edges widen invalidation; missing mapping forces full.

challenge.finding: Old PASS cannot prove new semantics.
challenge.resolution: Implementation hash invalidates gate and downstream dependents.

challenge.finding: Correctness criteria can change without local source change.
Cache poisoning could permit unsafe reuse.
challenge.resolution: Schema, checksum, completeness, branch and ancestry validation force full on mismatch.

challenge.finding: Partial PASS records could become a resume point.
challenge.resolution: Only finalized complete checkpoints are candidates.

challenge.scenario: Known Failure scope is wider than diff.
challenge.finding: Minimal replay could miss a recurring class.
challenge.resolution: Known Failure scope is an additive replay override.

challenge.scenario: Planner predicts REUSE but full gate fails.
challenge.finding: Reuse model produced a false PASS candidate.
challenge.resolution: Shadow comparison blocks the scope engine; full verification remains authority.

challenge.scenario: Docs-only commit creates a new HEAD.
challenge.resolution: Semantic fingerprint equivalence permits reuse while manifest binds validity to current HEAD and preserves origin.

challenge.scenario: Branch changes or checkpoint commit is not ancestor.
challenge.resolution: v1 forbids cross-branch/non-ancestor reuse and forces full.

challenge.scenario: A template source file changes only one canonical page, such as FAQ, while the prior 14x3 browser matrix is green.
challenge.finding: File-level hashing alone forces the full 42-case browser matrix and cannot safely distinguish unchanged page proofs.
challenge.resolution: Template Factory emits deterministic compiled Page Schema fingerprints per page. Page-level browser evidence is reusable only when the prior manifest is complete, checksummed, same-branch, ancestor-bound, full-green, same template/version, and the page fingerprint is identical. Shared Runtime/Factory authority changes still force the full matrix.

proofPlan: Exhaustive REUSABLE/INVALIDATED/UNKNOWN state tests with UNKNOWN always rerunning.
Truth Gate regression for reused evidence provenance and current exact-head validity.
Branch-scoped CI shadow restore/save with full-run comparison.
At least two exact-head CI cycles before physical gate-skipping promotion.

Template Factory proof: seed a complete checksummed 14x3 manifest, then prove a single-page fingerprint change reruns only that page across Desktop/Tablet/Mobile while reusing unchanged page evidence; corrupt/stale/branch-mismatched prior manifests force full matrix.

requirements.requirement: Build deterministic evidence identity from semantic inputs rather than commit SHA alone.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A previous PASS alone never authorizes reuse.

requirements.requirement: Model verification dependencies and compute fail-closed transitive invalidation.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Downstream dependents cannot remain reusable after upstream invalidation.

requirements.requirement: Reconcile branch-scoped checkpoints against every new exact HEAD before resume.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Dirty, corrupt, incomplete, non-ancestor or cross-branch checkpoints fail closed.

requirements.requirement: Classify prior evidence as REUSABLE, INVALIDATED or UNKNOWN and rerun UNKNOWN.
Let Known Failure regression scope widen the replay plan.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Minimal diff scope cannot override wider Known Failure regression scope.

requirements.requirement: Produce an auditable exact-head manifest for rerun and equivalence-proven reused proofs including origin revision.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Reused proof origin and equivalence reason are retained.

requirements.requirement: Expose mode, reuse/rerun/invalidation counts, replay reason, checkpoint source and explain decisions.
Run v1 in shadow mode and block on any predicted-reuse/full-verification disagreement.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Physical gate skipping is not promoted before shadow equivalence is proven.

requirements.requirement: Preserve existing Control Plane, Release Risk, Truth Gate and Template Factory ownership.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No parallel blocking workflow or release authority is created.

requirements.requirement: Prove local/shared/schema/authority/gate/config/unrelated/visual/transitive scenarios and safe fallback, including Template Factory page-level browser-case reuse with full 14x3 fallback.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Stale evidence, corrupted cache or unsupported state cannot produce final PASS.

notes: Control Plane resumable verification expanded within the existing 5-point Release Risk Budget to close Template Factory page-level browser replay. Planned release scope is quality-infrastructure + release-infrastructure + storefront-ui (5/5, three subsystems); DOMAIN-BUILDER is included only for the QA catalog page-fingerprint projection. Promotion is engine-identity-bound: any verification engine/policy change falls back to SHADOW and must re-earn promotion. No production runtime/template behavior is changed. Template Factory selective browser replay is implemented as a subordinate evidence checkpoint inside the existing Template Factory Quality Gate; no parallel workflow authority. Merge-readiness stress verification exposed a transient duplicate E13 acceptance root in the Product Owner functional-proof browser session; scope was widened to harden that existing runner with fail-closed cardinality convergence plus regression coverage. STRESS ONLY: Product Intake Center title source is deliberately changed without updating its cross-file regression consumer. STRESS ONLY: envelope reconciled to the deliberately added DOMAIN-ADMIN source surface so Plan does not mask Reference Sync. STRESS ONLY: acknowledges SQ-NK-006 activated by deliberate DOMAIN-ADMIN scope.
